definitions.explanation: A broad, general explanation or summary of a topic, covering the main points without going into great detail. Often used as a book title or section heading.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{文学|ぶんがく}{概説|がいせつ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read an overview of Japanese literature.

examples.japanese: まず{概説|がいせつ}から{始|はじ}めましょう。
この{授業|じゅぎょう}では{経済学|けいざいがく}の{概説|がいせつ}を{行|おこな}い、{基本的|きほんてき}な{理論|りろん}を{紹介|しょうかい}します。
examples.english: In this class, we will provide an overview of economics and introduce the basic theories.

notes:
USAGE:
{概説|がいせつ} is commonly used in academic contexts as a book or chapter title meaning "Introduction to" or "Survey of." The verb form {概説|がいせつ}する means to give a general explanation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概説|がいせつ}する (to give an overview)
- {概説|がいせつ}{書|しょ} (an introductory book, survey text)
- 〜{概説|がいせつ} (as a title: "Survey of ~")

RELATED WORDS:
- {概要|がいよう}: outline, summary
- {概論|がいろん}: general introduction (as a course or book title)
- {総説|そうせつ}: review article, general review
- {入門|にゅうもん}: introduction (beginner level)
